summary: HarmonyEditor processes media locally on the device to support clip selection, editing, and export workflows.

permissions.name: ohos.permission.READ_MEDIA
permissions.purpose: Read videos that the user selects from the local media library for editing.

permissions.name: ohos.permission.WRITE_MEDIA
permissions.purpose: Save exported videos from the app sandbox back to the user's media library.

details: Project metadata, clip trims, filter settings, audio settings, and export defaults are stored in the app's local relational database.
Temporary export files are written to the app sandbox before gallery save operations complete.

dataSharing.details: The app does not upload project data or media to remote services as part of the local editing workflow.
